commands.label: Parse the original with the published OpenRA MiniYAML-compatible reader

Cargo.toml.content_utf8:
[package]
name = "corpus-openra-miniyaml"
version = "0.0.0"
edition = "2021"
[dependencies]
cnc-formats = { version = "=0.1.0-alpha.5", default-features = false, features = ["miniyaml"] }

reproduction_command: cargo run --quiet with the recorded reader fixture
semantic_scope: The dedicated OpenRA-style MiniYAML reader materialized the exact original file as a two-level tree. Its Greeting/Text value matched the full greeting.
path_normalization: Temporary paths use stable placeholders. Source hashes refer to the repository files listed in artifact_sha256.
